points.description: States that the test compares observed data/frequencies (the sample's observed values) ...
... with the assumed/estimated/theoretical (fitted) probability distribution (PDF) or its expected values.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says 'distribution' or 'expected' loosely without clear link to the assumed/theoretical model.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the test measures the difference between observed data and the assumed/estimated/theoretical distribution (PDF), in any wording; 'expected' or 'theoretical' counts as a synonym for assumed. Give 1 mark if only one side is correct (e.g. observed only, or just 'a distribution'). Give 0 for unrelated or wrong answers.
